prompt: Single continuous shot. Beef strips dropped into a violently hot pan in a single layer, searing loudly, crust forming — tossed once in a flame flare. Mushrooms slide in with onions, tomato paste swirled through turning everything deep amber. Money shot: cream poured in a slow white spiral off the heat, folded until the sauce turns blush and silky, coating the beef in macro gloss. Final beat: ladled over white rice, potato sticks raining on top in slow motion, backlit steam. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the violent sear, then the cream fold. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
O strogonoff cremoso de verdade — sem ketchup aguado, sem mistério.
🧾 500g de filé em tiras · 1 cebola · champignon · 2 col. de extrato de tomate · 1 col. de mostarda · 1 caixinha de creme de leite
1. Sela as tiras em fogo ALTO, pouco por vez, reserva. 2. Cebola, champignon, extrato e mostarda na mesma panela. 3. Creme de leite fora do fogo, volta a carne, não ferve mais.
💡 Selar pouco por vez é a regra de ouro — panela cheia vira carne cozida cinza. Salva pro almoço de domingo 📌
